other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.postorder: fun postorder :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a list" where "postorder Leaf = []" | "postorder (Node (l) (x) (r)) = postorder l @ postorder r @ [x]"
formal function definitions.size: primrec size :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where "size Leaf = 0" | "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"
